stemMd: A machine receives 500 J of energy and performs 350 J of useful work. What is its efficiency?
explanationMd: Efficiency is useful output divided by input: 350/500=0.70, or 70%. The remaining 150 J accounts for 30% of the input.

distractorRationale.c: This does not follow the output/input ratio.
distractorRationale.e: This uses the energy difference as a percentage incorrectly.
